scope: Work-controlled Preview adoption of actual reviewed agent call-row patch; preserve original rejection, current source identity, historical replay and keyboard/browser coverage.
riskAnalysis: Exact one-label replacement already passed actual isolated tests. Primary risks are stale task reuse, historical readback regression and packaging drift; runtime admission remains fail-closed.

threatModel.assets: Immutable agent receipts, source identity, accessible call labels and task authorization history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Work source publication versus internal agent proposals, current source admission versus explicit historical test replay.
threatModel.abuseCases: Reusing stale patch grants, changing unrelated source, falsely rewriting the original model rejection or source evidence.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact before/after hashes, immutable old assets, new bounded evidence asset, stale assignment denial and independent QA/Auditor review.

rollback: Reviewed feature revert of the adoption commit only, paid execution disabled, preserve original receipts and historical source assets.

defects.rootCause: Repeated callers had identical accessible button names because call timestamps were excluded from aria-label.
defects.detectionGap: Prior browser click checks did not assert accessible names or keyboard activation, and original unchecked patch failed invalid-time behavior.
defects.regression: Exact genuine safe-time replacement, seven actual isolated cases, fifty focused adoption checks and authenticated browser accessible-name/Enter assertions.
defects.historicalPrevention: Review current-source admission and historical replay separately whenever publishing a source-bound agent patch.

proactiveReview.architecture: Exact agent patch and immutable evidence preserved; explicit current source and historical fixture separation independently reviewed. Full STRICT, Redis, security and actual Browser archive qualification required before release claim.
